# Source Data Notebook for Supplementary Figures

This notebook documents the single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analyses presented in the manuscript. It includes data preprocessing and figure generation for the supplementary figure.

📂 Bulk RNA-seq results are provided separately as Source Data files.

Title: ALK R1275Q mutation expands SCP-like cells during sympathoadrenal commitment and creates a permissive state for neuroblastoma initiation

Authors: Mingzhi Liu and Margareta Wilhelm

plots=list()
for (i in 1:length(genes_to_check)){
  tryCatch({
 
      plots[[i]] <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(seurat_object = ML_seurat_Ctrl, 
                                         colors_use = viridis_magma_dark_high, 
                                         features = genes_to_check[i], pt.size = 0.5)+NoLegend()+NoAxes()+
        theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,color = "black",
                                          size=1.5,linetype = "solid"))
    }
  , error=function(e){cat("ERROR :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")}) 
}
if(TRUE %in% sapply(plots, is.null)){
  plots <- plots[-which(sapply(plots, is.null))]
  p <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 6)
}else{
  p <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 6)
};p

library(monocle3)
sample_name <- names(ML_seurat_Ctrl)
data <- GetAssayData(ML_seurat_Ctrl, assay = "SCT", slot = "data")
cell_metadata <- ML_seurat_Ctrl@meta.data
gene_annotation <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(data))
rownames(gene_annotation) <- rownames(data)
cds <- new_cell_data_set(data,cell_metadata = cell_metadata,gene_metadata = gene_annotation)
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50)
cds <- reduce_dimension(cds, cores=8, preprocess_method = "PCA", reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds.embed <- cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP
int.embed <- Embeddings(ML_seurat_Ctrl, reduction = "umap")
int.embed <- int.embed[rownames(cds.embed),]
cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- int.embed

cds <- cluster_cells(cds)
cds <- learn_graph(cds)
myselect <- function(cds,select.classify,my_select){
  cell_ids <- which(colData(cds)[,select.classify] == my_select)
  closest_vertex <-
    cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  root_pr_nodes <-
    igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[as.numeric(names
                                                              (which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids,]))))]
  root_pr_nodes}

cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes=myselect(cds,select.classify = 'seurat_clusters',my_select = "2"))

p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime",label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE, label_leaves = FALSE, 
               label_branch_points = FALSE, cell_size = 1, trajectory_graph_segment_size = 2,group_label_size = 10 );p

seuratob <- readRDS("./PublishedData.d/halbritter_nc2024.d/FH_seurat_wt.RDS")
seuratob@meta.data$stage <- factor(seuratob@meta.data$stage, levels = c(paste0("D",c(0,3,6,9,10,12,14,19,28))))

seurat_list <- list("FH_NC" = seuratob, "MW" = ML_seurat_Ctrl)

ML_anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat_list, dims = 1:30, verbose = F)
RNA_Inte  <- IntegrateData(anchorset = ML_anchors, dims = 1:30, verbose = F)

RNA_Inte <- ScaleData(RNA_Inte) %>% RunPCA(verbose=FALSE)
RNA_Inte <- RunUMAP(RNA_Inte, dims = 1:20, verbose = F)
RNA_Inte <- FindNeighbors(RNA_Inte, dims = 1:20, verbose = F) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.2, verbose = F)

RNA_Inte@meta.data <- RNA_Inte@meta.data %>%
  mutate(stage_new = ifelse(is.na(stage), as.character(paste0(orig.ident,"_ML")), stage))

RNA_Inte@meta.data$stage_new <- factor(RNA_Inte@meta.data$stage_new, levels = c("NCC_ML", "SAP_ML", "D8_ML", "D12_ML",
                                                                                        "D0", "D3", "D6", "D9", "D10", "D12", 
                                                                                        "D14", "D19", "D28"))

raw_data <- data.frame(
  ID = factor(c("Ctrl", "NB1", "NB2", "NB4"), levels = c("Ctrl", "NB1", "NB2", "NB4")),
  Kappa = c(0.888, 0.593, 0.499, 0.655),
  PlotGroup = factor(c("Ctrl", "NBs", "NBs", "NBs"), levels = c("Ctrl", "NBs"))
)

summary_stats <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(PlotGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanKappa = mean(Kappa),
    SD = sd(Kappa),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(SD = ifelse(is.na(SD), 0, SD))

ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.81, ymax = 1.00, fill = "#238b45", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.90, label = "Almost Perfect Agreement (0.81-1.00)", color = "#238b45", fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
  
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.61, ymax = 0.80, fill = "#74c476", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.70, label = "Substantial Agreement (0.61-0.80)", color = "#74c476", fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
  
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.41, ymax = 0.60, fill = "#fd8d3c", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.50, label = "Moderate Agreement (0.41-0.60)", color = "#e6550d", fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
  
  geom_bar(data = summary_stats, aes(x = as.numeric(PlotGroup), y = MeanKappa, fill = PlotGroup), 
           stat = "identity", width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_stats, aes(x = as.numeric(PlotGroup), ymin = MeanKappa - SD, ymax = MeanKappa + SD), 
                width = 0.1, color = "black") +
  
  geom_jitter(data = raw_data, aes(x = as.numeric(PlotGroup), y = Kappa, color = ID), 
              size = 4, alpha = 0.9, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, seed = 123)) +
  
  geom_text(data = raw_data, aes(x = as.numeric(PlotGroup), y = Kappa, label = sprintf("%.3f", Kappa)), 
            position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, seed = 123), 
            hjust = -0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  
  geom_text(data = summary_stats, aes(x = as.numeric(PlotGroup), y = MeanKappa, label = sprintf("%.3f", MeanKappa)), 
            vjust = -2.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ctrl" = "#4575B4", "NBs" = "#D73027")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ctrl" = "black", "NB1" = "#96281BFF", "NB2" = "#FF73B3FF", "NB4" = "#891FCCFF")) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Ctrl", "NBs")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Prediction Consistency (Cohen's Kappa)", y = "Kappa Coefficient", x = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"))
  ggsave(("./plots.d/NC_Revision_DelayDifferentiation_Kappa.pdf"),height = 6, width = 9)

                          reference = ref,

                          reference.reduction = "pca", 
                          reduction.model = "umap")

results <- read.csv(paste0(plot.path, "./Cluster5_combined_surface_marker.csv"))
results <- results %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(gene1, gene2, sep = "+"))

top20 <- results %>%
  arrange(desc(weighted_specificity)) %>%
  slice(1:15)

highlight_pairs <- c(top20$pair, "ERBB3+NGFR")

label_df <- results %>%
  filter(pair %in% highlight_pairs) %>%
  mutate(label_color = ifelse(pair == "ERBB3+NGFR", "red", "black"))
  

ggplot(results, aes(x = dp_cluster5, y = dp_other)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_log2FC, color = weighted_specificity), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_label_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = pair), 
                   color = label_df$label_color, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_classic2() +
  labs(title = "Marker pair specificity",
       x = "Double-positive in SAP_5",
       y = "Double-positive in Others",
       size = "Mean log2FC",
       color = "Weighted specificity")
